candidate_note: baseline has no candidate counter; unavailable values are null
completion_fence_wait_note: wall time includes asynchronous queueing and frame scheduling, not exact CPU blocked-on-GPU time
counter_scope: particle-pair and big-contact candidates/confirmed contacts (including sniper-kind-big); excludes complete wall/terrain-DDA and shield/core geometry query counts
current_rule_note: no emission cost; all high-energy territory captures spend1E and continue; fixed-rate MG distributes remaining plus refill energy over10simulation seconds
fixture: deterministic initial state upload, production compute thereafter
fps_note: drawn FPS includes async fence wait; completed fixed-step throughput separately reported; software Vulkan is not RTX 5060 Ti performance
physical_vram_note: RenderingDevice allocations are not measured VRAM residency
